subject: Municipal Charter Commission and Infrastructure Repairs
overview: The Council moved to redraft a proposal for a nine-member municipal charter commission and addressed critical infrastructure needs, including library roof leaks, citywide traffic planning, and sidewalk parking enforcement.

items.title: Municipal Charter Commission
items.summary: Approved referring a redrafted proposal for a nine-member municipal charter commission to the City Solicitor following a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: National Grid Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved a petition for underground conduit at 28 Governor's Avenue with an amendment requiring a restoration inspection within 30 days.

items.title: Charter Commission Forum
items.summary: Received and placed on file a redundant resolution regarding the creation of a charter commission.

items.title: Medford Public Library Roof
items.summary: Approved a resolution to replace the library roof immediately and requested reports on the building's overall structural health and potential air quality issues.

items.title: Sidewalk Parking Enforcement
items.summary: Approved a resolution for increased enforcement of sidewalk parking and requested that the Traffic Commission evaluate restricting commercial delivery hours and escalating fines.

items.title: Traffic Engineer Consultant
items.summary: Approved a resolution to hire a traffic engineer or consultant to review citywide patterns and mitigate development impacts.

items.title: DPW Pothole Repair Plan
items.summary: Approved requesting a proactive pothole repair plan from the DPW and referred a recommendation for road-scanning technology to the department.

items.title: Business Permitting Update
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on expediting business permits and creating instructional pamphlets for new entrepreneurs.

items.title: Taxi Operator Licenses
items.summary: Tabled two petitions for taxi operator licenses because the petitioners were not present.

items.title: Broken Parking Meter Repair
items.summary: Approved a request to repair a meter at 451 High Street and requested a report on the city's policies regarding parking at disabled meters.

items.title: EMS Service Zone Plan
items.summary: Approved requesting a status update from the Fire Chief regarding the deployment plan for emergency medical personnel.

items.title: Public Participation: Cemetery and Green Burials
items.summary: Discussed the potential for green burials at Oak Grove Cemetery and the possible formation of a cemetery advisory board.

items.title: Announcements and Condolences
items.summary: Extended condolences to the family of Amabile Billy Rizzo and announced upcoming public input sessions for economic development.
